known.via: English Wikipedia "Cotnari" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A Romanian PDO named for a wine village in Iaşi County, in Western Moldavia, known for the Grasă de Cotnari grape. Its rules allow still, sparkling and aromatic sparkling wine from grapes such as Grasă de Cotnari, Fetească Albă, Frâncuşă and Tămâioasă Românească.
